card.name: Monitoring and maintenance wording before doses
card.fires_on: Words like "each", "maintain" and "maintenance" in monitoring or dosing instructions, such as blood counts before each dose or drug level monitoring. Also partway through "digoxin" and "lipodystrophy".

modes.label: Before each dose or cycle
modes.description: The word "each" after "prior to" or "before" in instructions to check blood counts.
modes.example: Obtain complete blood counts with differential at the start of therapy and prior to<< each>> subsequent dose of IVRA.

modes.description: Words about keeping drug levels or schedules steady.
